meta.title: Festival
meta.description: Light and darkness shape day and night; the battle is about to begin.

units.rawText: And now for the festival's special event – "Inverted Mordent Resonance!"

units.rawText: We hope you'll help us out! Kuro and Nanaka are looking forward to how everyone will do!

units.rawText: That NEET administrator really went all-out this time...

units.rawText: As I thought, the climactic special event is going to be a Mysterious Warrior show after all! How will the final battle between Mysterious Warrior Omega and Dark Warrior unfold?

units.rawText: Relax, Nanaka. The Professor might be a far cry from me, but at times like these, you can't go wrong by believing in them.

units.rawText: But this place is different. The mood here is a lot like my expeditions in the past, where everyone was laughing and encouraging each other as they headed toward an ideal future.
